title: Jacquard, a programming language for AI-written, human-reviewed code
claim: Show HN: Jacquard, a programming language for AI-written, human-reviewed code
why_good: A programming language designed for AI-written, human-reviewed code — an interesting bet that AI-era code needs review-first language design.
value: Languages monetize via tooling/cloud around them; distant, and only with real adoption.
risk: New languages almost never get adopted; 'AI-reviewable' must show concrete wins over linting existing languages.

zh.claim: Show HN: Jacquard —— 一门为 AI 写、人类审 代码设计的编程语言。
zh.why_good: 一门为 AI 写、人类审 代码设计的语言——一个有意思的押注:AI 时代的代码需要审查优先的语言设计。
zh.value: 语言靠围绕它的工具/云变现;很遥远,且需真被采用。
zh.risk: 新语言几乎从不被采用;AI 可审 必须相对现有语言的 lint 展示具体优势。
